basic_info.description: Welcome to 40 Pico, a lovely colonial residence located on a huge corner lot in sought after Ingleside Terrace. This beautiful home blends classic elegance with modern conveniences. Upon entering, you are greeted by a gracious staircase and a central floor plan offering an effortless flow between its artistically designed living spaces. The main level boasts a large living room with a charming wood-burning fireplace, a formal dining room perfect for entertaining and an updated kitchen with an inviting breakfast area opening to a spacious deck and side garden. In addition, this level offers a bedroom/office and full bath. The upper level features three good sized bedrooms plus two full baths. The primary bedroom includes a large walk-in closet and private dressing area. The additional two bedrooms are of generous size and filled with light.        The lower level features a large space and a full bath that can be used as a media room, an additional bedroom, or an au-pair suite. This area caters to a variety of lifestyle needs.  The home also has a newer roof with solar panels, enhancing energy efficiency.  From its elegant design to its modern upgrades,40 Pico is a residence that truly has it all.
